newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lufthansa Cathay plan 11th HK-FRA freighter.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cathay plan 11th HK-FRA freighter.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said it will put on an 11th weekly Boeing 747-200 freighter, providing a further 100 tonnes of uplift, on the Hong Kong to Frankfurt route at end-October due to the strong demand for air cargo space.
The extra flight forms part of the Lufthansa and Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd joint venture for Hong Kong to Germany cargo. In September an 10th freighter was added to cope with rising demand.

"We would like to have that 11th freighter today or even yesterday. At the moment it's not feasible because we can't get an aircraft but we could easily fill it," said Frank Berweger, Lufthansa Cargo's general manager in Hong Kong, South China and Macau.
Lufthansa is reporting 100 per cent load factors on all its aircraft leaving Hong Kong since early July, he added.

And that is despite a HK$3 a kg rate rise imposed on August the first by all major carriers to European destinations with another HK$2 a kg rise due on October 1 try and boost yield, industry sources said. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
